_comment: InviteStash Root Template Registry — Single source of truth. Only REAL templates with working index.html files are listed here. Each category has a per-category JSON at public/templates/<category>/<category>.json and each template has its own template.json in its sub-folder.

categories.label: Weddings
categories.description: Premium animated wedding e-invitations with music, animations, and personalized itineraries.

categories.label: Birthdays
categories.description: Fun, vibrant birthday invitation templates for all ages.

templates.name: Anjali & Maneet Grand Invite
templates.description: A grand multi-page animated wedding e-invite for Anjali & Maneet. Featuring envelope reveal animation, ceremony itinerary, animated Ganesh blessing, photo gallery, and traditional music. Rich maroon-gold palette with hand-crafted floral motifs throughout.
templates.imageAlt: Anjali & Maneet grand luxurious animated wedding invitation

templates.name: Golden Door Reveal
templates.description: A breathtaking animated wedding e-invite where two ornate golden temple doors swing open dramatically to unveil the invitation inside. Deep navy and gold palette with filigree patterns and ambient bokeh lighting creates a cinematic, unforgettable reveal.
templates.imageAlt: Golden Door animated wedding invitation — ornate doors opening
highlights: Deep navy and gold color theme

templates.name: Royal Grand Invite
templates.description: The flagship Royal Grand Invite — a fully interactive animated wedding e-invite. Features peacock motif splash screen, envelope opening reveal, multi-page event schedule, photo gallery, animated countdown timer, and embedded background music. The gold-emerald palette evokes true royal opulence.
templates.imageAlt: Royal Grand interactive animated wedding e-invite with peacock motif

templates.name: Floral Bloom
templates.description: A beautifully crafted floral wedding e-invite bathed in soft blush pinks and rose golds. Watercolor-style floral borders of peonies, roses, and jasmine frame the invitation with a delicate, romantic touch.
templates.imageAlt: Floral Bloom romantic blush pink wedding invitation
highlights: Soft blush pink and rose gold palette

templates.name: Curtain Reveal
templates.description: A show-stopping wedding e-invite where rich crimson velvet curtains dramatically part at center stage to reveal the invitation. Golden rope tassels, warm spotlight, and rose petals falling complete the theatrical atmosphere.
templates.imageAlt: Curtain Reveal dramatic crimson velvet wedding e-invite

templates.name: Silk Drape
templates.description: An ethereal and dreamy wedding e-invite featuring sheer lavender silk curtains that gently part to unveil the invitation in soft, floating motion. Fairy lights glow through the translucent fabric as flower petals drift down.
templates.imageAlt: Silk Drape lavender sheer curtain wedding e-invite

templates.name: Honey Bear Birthday
templates.description: A delightfully animated birthday e-invite themed around a honey-loving bear. Warm amber honeycomb backgrounds, a playful cartoon bear with balloons and birthday cake, dripping honey border animations, and a cheerful birthday song make this invite irresistibly fun for kids and adults alike.
templates.imageAlt: Honey Bear animated birthday party invitation
highlights: Birthday cake with candle lighting effect
